title: Explicit knowledge status
description: One declaration that a page, a record, or one of its fields is not simply documented. The five statuses have distinct meanings and distinct values, and a subject with no declaration is `missing`, which is not one of them. A declaration with no `status` is read as `unknown`. The parser in `src/knowledge/parse.ts` validates untrusted input against this schema shape and reports every invalid value at its exact source span.

status.description: unknown: nothing establishes the answer; unsupported: the engine or site cannot represent or perform it; unverified: a claim exists without confirming evidence; not-applicable: the question does not apply to this subject; out-of-scope: the answer sits outside what this site is responsible for.

scope.description: The dimensions the claim is limited to, such as platform windows or version v2. Empty or absent means the claim applies everywhere.

rationale.description: Why the subject has this status. Private unless `public` is true; public output replaces it with a placeholder.

citation.description: Where the evidence is. The value is redacted in public output unless it is marked public.

public.description: true publishes the rationale; absent or false keeps it private.

expires.description: A date after which the declaration must be reviewed; compared against an explicit as-of date, never the clock.

evidence.description: The evidence the declaration was written against; a different current value flags it for review.

scope.description: One scope limit, either as `{ kind, value }` or as `kind:value`.
